sampling.rationale: Complete regular lattice clipped by distance from the primary profile. Every included origin was searched for every query.

collection_policy.purpose: Regional visibility from each sampled origin, without Search this area restriction.
collection_policy.interpretation: Not returned means absent from this top-30 Maps response, not proof of no service or no visibility under every Google experience.

evidence.roster_policy: Primary Google Business Profile plus nine competing profiles. Separate locations remain separate competitors even when names and websites match. Rank-weighted visibility sums 21 minus organic rank (ranks 1–20) over all origins and queries equally. Ties: top-three appearances, then appearances, then CID. The roster stays fixed across queries. Eligibility follows the service-category filter recorded in the study plan. All returned listings through the requested depth remain available in location evidence. This measures visibility on this footprint, not revenue or market share.
evidence.boundary_policy: Discrete measured locations. No continuous market boundary or customer-demand estimate.
